quarterly_data.quarter: AMEC results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 collective (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 collective results briefing: chairman Yin Zhiyao said AMEC's production bases are Jinqiao, Lingang phase 1 and Nanchang; the Lingang headquarters and R&D center was inaugurated on August 1, 2026; the Guangzhou South China base and the Chengdu southwest base are each expected to start production in H1 2027; plant floor area is now 60 ten-thousand square metres and will grow to 90 ten-thousand square metres over the next five years, with Lingang phase 2 to start construction in H2 2026. As orders enter large-scale delivery it works with its supply chain to raise delivery capacity, holds strategic stock of overseas core parts as a priority customer of its overseas suppliers and keeps adding domestic parts. CFO Chen Weiwen said H1 operating cash flow was RMB 6.85 hundred million, up 237.39%. At June 30, 2026 it had 3,680 staff, including 1,908 in R&D (51.85%).
quarterly_data.figure: floor area 60 to 90 ten-thousand square metres over five years; H1 operating cash flow RMB 6.85 hundred million (+237.39%)
